description: Live cross-DEX pool prices, liquidity and gross cross-venue spreads on 6 EVM chains, read from on-chain pool state at a stated block. Works keyless.

notes: api-key, optional RAPIDAPI_KEY — the server starts and answers without one

Metadata supplied by maintainer @donnywin85 in issue #1852. The server is stdio-only, starts keyless against a free hourly public snapshot, and uses optional RAPIDAPI_KEY only for live per-block reads and per-pair history.
Sources include https://github.com/donnywin85/arb-dex-mcp, https://donnywin85.github.io/arb-dex-mcp/, https://www.npmjs.com/package/arb-dex-mcp, and MCP Registry id io.github.donnywin85/arb-dex-mcp.
